query:
SELECT t.id, t.email, t.companyName, at.token as activationToken, at.expiresAt 
FROM tenants t 
LEFT JOIN activationTokens at ON t.id = at.tenantId 
WHERE t.email = 'cliente@teste.com' 
ORDER BY t.createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 1;
